description: List the household's payrolls, newest first, each with its status, pay period, pay date, total gross pay, total net pay, employer taxes, the employee_ids it paid and paid_outside_confirmation (for paychecks paid outside NannyKeeper: confirmed, mismatch, waiting, or null when nobody was asked). Filter with employee_id (only payrolls that paid that employee) and pay_date_from / pay_date_to (inclusive pay-date range, YYYY-MM-DD). Use limit for "the last three payrolls" (limit: 3). When has_more is true, pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page; a cursor it did not issue answers invalid_cursor, so start again without one. Totals are for the whole payroll; call get_payroll with a payroll id for each employee's gross pay, deductions and net pay. Report the exact status: scheduled or processing does not mean paid, and a voided payroll paid nothing. An employee_id that is not in this household answers not_found. Read-only.

cursor.description: Optional. The next_cursor from a previous call, for the next page.

employee_id.description: Optional. Only payrolls that paid this employee. Get it from list_employees.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

limit.description: Optional. How many payrolls to return, 1 to 100 (default 25).

pay_date_from.description: Optional. Earliest pay date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

pay_date_to.description: Optional. Latest pay date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: list_payrolls
